user_story: As a user, I want to log in to my bank account using my username and password so that I can access my banking services securely.
acceptance_criteria: The login page title should be 'ParaBank | Welcome | Online Banking'.
The page should display a heading 'Customer Login'.
The username input field should be present with name 'username' and class 'input'.
The password input field should be present with name 'password' and class 'input'.
The login button should be present with value 'Log In' and class 'button'.
Upon entering valid credentials and clicking 'Log In', the user should be redirected to the account dashboard.
cypress_script: describe('Bank Login and Navigation', () => { it('should log in successfully with valid credentials', () => { cy.visit('https://parabank.parasoft.com/parabank/index.htm'); cy.get('input[name="username"]').type('validUsername'); cy.get('input[name="password"]').type('validPassword'); cy.get('input[value="Log In"]').click(); cy.url().should('include', '/account.htm'); }); it('should show an error with invalid credentials', () => { cy.visit('https://parabank.parasoft.com/parabank/index.htm'); cy.get('input[name="username"]').type('invalidUsername'); cy.get('input[name="password"]').type('invalidPassword'); cy.get('input[value="Log In"]').click(); cy.get('div#bodyPanel').should('contain', 'The username and password could not be verified.'); }); });
playwright_script: import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test'; test('Bank Login and Navigation', async ({ page }) => { await page.goto('https://parabank.parasoft.com/parabank/index.htm'); await page.fill('input[name="username"]', 'validUsername'); await page.fill('input[name="password"]', 'validPassword'); await page.click('input[value="Log In"]'); await expect(page).toHaveURL(/.*account.htm/); }); test('should show an error with invalid credentials', async ({ page }) => { await page.goto('https://parabank.parasoft.com/parabank/index.htm'); await page.fill('input[name="username"]', 'invalidUsername'); await page.fill('input[name="password"]', 'invalidPassword'); await page.click('input[value="Log In"]'); await expect(page.locator('div#bodyPanel')).toContainText('The username and password could not be verified.'); }); }
